statement: Positive lower density of large prime gaps. For every fixed C > 0, a positive proportion of consecutive prime gaps exceed $`C\log p_n`$, throughout every sufficiently large initial segment of the primes. The proportion may depend on C. Consequently, the indices where $`p_n/n`$ increases have positive lower density, answering Erdős and Prachar.
